intro.title: Right to Information
intro.description: The Right to Information Act, 2005 enables citizens to request information held by public authorities and promotes transparency and accountability.

process.title: RTI Application Process
process.description: Follow these general steps when submitting an RTI application.
process.stepOne: Clearly identify the information you need.
process.stepTwo: Submit the application to the concerned Public Information Officer.
process.stepThree: Pay the applicable fee or attach proof of fee exemption.
process.stepFour: Keep the acknowledgement and wait for the response.

rights.title: Citizens' Right to Information
rights.description: Under the Right to Information Act, 2005, citizens may request information held by public authorities, subject to the Act's provisions and exemptions.
